notes.title: UPDATE
notes.content:
With the update,

-Drunk state added
-AI players should not go under the ground while dribbling now
-AI players should not use speedhack now, hopefully. (Please mention about it if the problem occurs again)
-AI players should not be still. (Please mention about it if the problem occurs again)
-Ball dropping point cursors should now disappear

You can check out other small fixes in Discussions/BUGs. Also feel free to write the bugs you've encountered.

Have fun !

notes.title: UPDATE
notes.content:
Updates
With the update,

-Gks should save more
-Hearse hitbox's changed
-Some code was being tweaked to get rid of the paralyzed gk
-Corner hitboxes' tweaked
-Special shoot glow effect added to be able to indicate that someone is ready to shoot it
-Pass mechanic changed into percentage system so that we can pass long or short distance
-Player control indicator should color differently now

You can check out other small fixes in Discussions/BUG. Also feel free to write the bugs you've encountered.

Have fun !
